player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakatākaro {player_id} e tākaro ana i te kēmu o Checkers hei {color}.
Tākaroa tō kī i te tuhinga whakarite o te chess [fileRank fileRank], pērā ki '[b2c3]' (reta o te pou a–h, tau o te rārangi 0–7).
Ngā ture kāore e:
  • Neke whakakorokoro whakamua mā 1 ki te wātea.
  • Hopukia mā te peke atu i tētahi kōwae o te hoa whawhai.
  • He Kinged te kōwae ki te tae atu ki te pito whakamuri.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore i kitea he whakapūmau whakamātau. Whakamahia [a1b2], hei tauira [b2c3].
invalid_move.illegal: Ko te kī [{move}] he kī kāore e tika ana.

outcome.red_no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro a te Whero. Ka wikitoria te Pango!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro i toe ki te pango. Ka wikitoria a Whero!
outcome.no_moves: Kāore he nekehanga i toe ki te kaitākaro {player_id}.
